text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Nippon Derby
was an overwhelming victory for Duramente—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Duramente in the lead! Duramente in the lead!
There is no one left to stop her! Crossing the line for glorious first place is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Duramente!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Behold the crystallization of pedigree, a miraculous run!! Strong, utterly strong, Duramente! A new era begins!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaaa, you're amazing, Duramenteーー!
Keep this up and you'll be the "World's Strongest"ーーー!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Are these... cheers...? The ground is shaking—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (It feels... like something happening in a completely different world...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Good work, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like I wasn't prepared enough.
Even though you went out of your way to pace with me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To be honest—I'm frustrated.
I thought I wouldn't let anyone claim
'the strongest of our generation' so easily...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I... failed to show it...
The pride of a Satono...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Crown-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No good, this is no time to be gloomy.
Starting today, I have to train myself back up again...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
See you later, Cheval.
Let's run together again—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Crown-san's... voice was trembling...
Even so, she didn't look down...)

text_block_list.name: Race Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *sniff*.
It's... over, the Derby...
I promised I'd win... no matter what... *sob*...

text_block_list.name: Race Participant Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I worked so hard for today... all this time...!
Damn it, damn it, damn it!
I could have done so much better!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......It's not just Crown-san.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(She's... she's giving it her all too...
Yeah... that's right...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
What am I doing...?
I can't even bring myself to feel frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wait in the underground walkway to greet
Cheval Grand, who ran off the turf with her head hung low.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I'm so embarrassed...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is so frustrated and devastated...
And yet, I... still can't feel that way myself...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Somewhere deep down... I always thought I could never win...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If you don't bet everything and give it your all,
you shouldn't even have the right to feel frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm so pathetic...
Leaving things half-done like this... I—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: What frustrates me the most is that I can't even feel properly frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I headed back to the waiting room with Cheval Grand,
comforting her as she slumped her shoulders in defeat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From behind, the still-fervent cheers
calling out to Duramente echoed on—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —I shall perpetually demonstrate what it means to be the "strongest"...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Because that is my pride and my mission...
I declare—I will definitely win next time as well...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Duramenteeeee!!!!
Win this and show us you're the strongest in the worlddd!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, amidst a whirlwind of wild enthusiasm,
the Japanese Derby drew to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as declared beforehand,
Duramente made her immense power as the "strongest in the nation" fully known to all—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
……*sob*…… *sniff*.
Ugh…… aah……!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's... over...
The Derby... my...—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ......Teio-san...
